summary.intent: Package the pinned tsrs TypeScript checker so it installs alongside Caliper (ADR 0026 S8, trail #280), with a single pin and a single resolution function, without changing any default.
summary.outcome: Subagent S8a finished and pushed PR #434 with four signed commits; the PR body was written and no checks are failing, with Entire Gates awaiting the user. The S8a worker was stopped and a summary was given. Only macOS arm64 was exercised locally.

repo: The tsrs pin lives once in crates/semantic/TSRS_VERSION. Rust compiles it into SUPPORTED_VERSIONS, and scripts/check-packaging.mjs (part of `just lint`) fails unless all 10 platform manifests and the oracle's tsrs match it.

Each CLI and napi platform package (packages/{cli,napi}/npm/<plat>) carries an exact-pinned optional dependency on its matching @tsrs/<plat>. The main packages, vite plugin and storybook addon have none. pnpm installs dependencies in a package's own store directory, and only the platform package's directory sits above the running binary.

Checker resolution is one function, `find_tsc` in crates/semantic/src/locate.rs, shared by the CLI and napi. Order: --tsc-path/tscPath, then @tsrs/<plat> in the nearest node_modules above the running binary, then the project's typescript/bin/tsc, then tsrs/bin/tsrs. There is no env var.
The CLI finds its own location via current_exe, and napi via node_api_get_module_file_name (napi9). gnu vs musl is decided at build time.
Dependabot now ignores tsrs and @tsrs/* because a pin change requires the tsrs-versus-Go parity run (ADR 0026).
A new public field `binary_dir` on SemanticRequest and OnDemandConfig requires a minor bump for caliper-docgen-semantic (checked via `just semver`).
The repo has a scripts rule: scripts must have CI callers. verify-checker-install.sh satisfies it via the new install-binaries job and the install matrix (npm/pnpm, Node 24/26).
No win32-arm64 tsrs package exists. Per-platform packed/unpacked sizes: darwin-arm64 10.5/23.9 MB, darwin-x64 11.1/25.4, linux-x64-gnu 15.4/35.2, linux-arm64-gnu 20.4/43.4, win32-x64 20.2/50.2.

code.finding: Home of find_tsc, the single checker-resolution function used by both the CLI and napi; it has 19 new unit tests covering lookup and file URLs.
The worker's own edit was dropped in favor of main's version when merging origin/main.
